summary: Makes the teach-family examples actually runnable so the live dogfood gate can exercise them: teach and teach-pattern examples switch from placeholder/backslash-continuation/background-ampersand shape (`--query "<question>" ... \ --resource <id> &`) to single-line concrete commands. teach's JSON success envelope no longer gated behind --quiet (quiet defaults true, which made --json emit nothing and fail the json_fidelity check). Adds .manuscripts/<run-id>/research/research.json synthesized from the manifest's novel_features (the dogfood matrix uses research.json for novel-feature validation).
reason: The publish live gate (Step 4.5) failed teach/teach-pattern: the generated example text is documentation-shaped (placeholders, `\` continuations, `&` background marker), not a runnable command, and teach --json exited 0 with empty stdout. Fixes are template defects; upstream generator should adopt runnable examples + unconditional JSON envelope (see upstream_issue).
validated_outcome: Live dogfood gate PASS (65 tests, 0 failed, 40 skipped); publish validate all 11 checks PASS.
upstream_issue: cli-printing-press: teach/teach-pattern examples not runnable (placeholders, backslash continuations, trailing &); teach JSON envelope gated behind --quiet defaulting true. Companion engine fix: liveDogfoodExampleArgs parses examples line-by-line and drops backslash-continuation flags.
